prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop website hero composition study, 16:10 landscape
Primary request: Create a second composition for Flevio’s locked “Live Type Atelier” desktop hero. This is a real conversion-focused website UI mockup, not a poster. Preserve the existing floating header silhouette exactly in role: top-left black rounded-square logo beside EN/KA pill, tiny centered FLEVIO wordmark, top-right white Menu pill. Do not redesign the header.
Structure: warm-white full viewport divided by an invisible editorial grid. Put “WE BUILD” as a smaller but still bold line at upper-left below the header; stretch “WEBSITES” as the enormous focal word nearly edge-to-edge across the center; place “THAT CONVERT” along the lower-right aligned to the focal word. Give one letter of WEBSITES a cherry-red technical selection box, dashed outline, handles and tiny measurement label to imply the supplied TechText interaction. Place a short value paragraph in a narrow left column near the lower third: “Custom websites shaped around your business, designed to earn trust and turn attention into action.” Place a prominent cherry-red “CONTACT US” button directly beneath it. Place “CUSTOM DESIGN · HAND-CODED DEVELOPMENT” as a quiet vertical or stacked note on the far right.
Visual system: translate the supplied gradient background into Warm White #EFEDE6 with a restrained radial depth, several broad diagonal Cherry Red #CD0000 streaks fading through masks, and a faint 20px dot pattern. Keep streaks behind type and reserve calm space around supporting copy.
Typography: ownable wide grotesk display, near-black #151412, precise tight tracking no more than -0.04em. Clean supporting sans.
Constraints: desktop hero only, clarity before decoration, no cards, no glass, no gradient text, no orange, no geographic trust claim, no fake awards, counts, reviews, partnerships, or logos. Exact headline and CTA text must remain legible. Show a hairline edge of the next section at bottom.
